subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should configured TTS providers remain first-choice-with-fallback, or should an explicit messages.tts.provider make OpenClaw fail rather than play another provider?
rationale: Current source, docs, tests, and the latest release preserve cross-provider fallback; changing it would be a user-visible policy change, not a narrow source-only bug fix.

options.title: Preserve documented fallback
options.body: Keep the current fallback semantics and narrow this issue to live proof of a distinct post-success delivery bug before changing code.

options.title: Enforce provider stickiness
options.body: Change speech-core so an explicitly selected provider fails instead of falling through to other providers, then update docs and tests.

options.title: Add opt-in strict mode
options.body: Introduce a deliberate strict/no-fallback surface, accepting extra config complexity to avoid breaking current fallback users by default.

recommendation.title: Preserve documented fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the current fallback semantics and narrow this issue to live proof of a distinct post-success delivery bug before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the partial TTS diagnostics fixes and documented the remaining provider-stickiness scope in the issue discussion.
